entry.title: Shark Jack Display
entry.summary:
Vendor: Hak5
Type: Pen Testing
Price: 185.00

INTRODUCTION

The original Shark Jack devices are powerful, portable network pentesting devices for rapid deployment of payloads. Easy payload updates, situation-aware adaptability and interactivity were skipped in order to optimise for simplicity and speed.

The Shark Jack Display changes everything: still ultra-portable, still speed-optimised - but with the inclusion of an OLED display and rocker-switch - ethernet audits are now interactive.

Interact with payloads in real-time and see live results on-screen. Scan a network, read the output, dig deeper - all on-device, no computer necessary.

The Shark Jack Display natively runs Bash and interactive DuckyScript™: payloads can now request your input, branch on results and drive any Linux network tool.

The device ships with preloaded payloads: over a dozen built-in payloads, and can automatically download new updates.

Finally, sys-admins with two Shark Jacks can use SharkLink™ - to finally get a quick solution the age-old problem: easily tell if there's a route between two different ports.

Real-time results on-screen

A 1.2" OLED gives you real-time results and rapid configuration. Read scans live, on-device, with no laptop in sight.

Interactive payloads

Bash and interactive DuckyScript™ let you prompt, branch and drive Linux network tools on the fly.

Powerful and Portable

Built to survive on your keychain. Deploys in seconds - forget it until you need it.

Training included

Hours of Hak5-produced step-by-step learning videos and online quizzes. Effortlessly gain expertise.

SEE IT IN ACTION

Get hands on with the Shark Jack Display's creator, Hak5's Darren Kitchen. See how easy network audits become with interactive payloads, on-screen results, phone-based control via C2 cloud.

GETTING STARTED: THE CRASH COURSE

The Shark Jack Display ships with a complete training course: hours of video walking you from the first boot to crafting your own payloads. Work through it at your own pace - every module is below.

1. Unboxing & Setup

Power on, LED indicators, battery and first boot - get your Shark Jack Display ready for action.

2. Operation Modes

Arming Mode, Attack Mode and the NETMODE settings that decide how every payload behaves.

3. Firmware Update & Get Payloads

Update firmware from the device itself and pull the latest community payloads - no computer necessary.

4. Interface Tour

Navigate the on-device menus: Payloads, Tools, Settings and About.

5. Payload Execution

Run your first payload, read the Payload Log live, and quit a running script safely.

6. Profiles

Save, load and manage per-payload configurations with DuckyScript™ Payload Profiles.

7. Crafting Payloads

Gain root over SSH and build your own payload from the shell.

8. SharkLink

Deploy two Shark Jack Displays and verify exactly which network ports connect to which.

UNDERSTAND THE SHARK JACK DISPLAY

1. OLED Display

1.2" high-contrast 128×64 OLED with a wide viewing angle - live payload output, on-device.

2. RGB-LED RJ45

Backlit RJ45 with RGB attack-mode and charge-status indication. Know its state at a glance.

3. USB-C Charging

Charge from any USB source - including some smartphones - with onboard BMS and LED indicator.

4. Rocker Switch

Tactile, single-finger navigation from a spring-loaded rocker switch and button combo.

5. Integrated Clip

Anti-snag RJ45 cover protects the plug and doubles as a convenient keychain loop.

6. Serviceable Battery

Serviceable 110 mAh LiPo on a JST connector - 30+ minutes of untethered runtime.

HOW IT COMPARES

There are three models in the SharkJack family - each one optimised for a specific environment: headless, tethered, or interactive. The Display adds an on-device screen and interactive payloads to the platform that made rapid physical-access network attacks routine.

entry.title: O.MG Adapter Elite
entry.summary:
Vendor: Hak5
Type:
Price: 295.00

INTRODUCTION

Over the years, the capabilities of O.MG cables has evolved rapidly, becoming more and more advanced.

Scripting, payloads, keystroke injection, wireless administration, stealth modes, self-destruct, geo-fencing, remote triggers and so much more - have turned these cables into a deeply comprehensive physical payload platform.

After much demand, the power of O.MG cables is available in other form-factors!

The O.MG Adapter Elite is embedded in USB-A to USB-C "OTG" Cable.

In this form factor - it's guaranteed to never arouse suspicion. When dormant - it acts as a typical USB 2.0 adapter - completely undetectable. When activated, payloads are delivered on the USB-C side of the adapter.

Even better - the cable will act as an O.TG cable - making it perfect for mobile payloads!

Important: The O.MG Plug is shipped in deactivated mode - it requires flashing before use. We recommend using the O.MG Programmer - which is compatible with all O.MG devices and cables. Flashing is performed easily via any web-browser.

FEATURES

  • WebUI over WiFi: Control everything remotely with a web browser. Desktop or mobile.
  • Keystroke Injection: Instant DuckyScript payloads. No recompiling or reprogramming, just click run! And with industry-leading 890keys/sec speeds.
  • Lots of Payload slots: Storage allows up to 300 slots!
  • Global Keymaps: With 192 keymaps already built in, you can target machines across the world.
  • Built in IDE: The WebUI not only provides 100% of the controls, but also gives you helpful feedback to catch syntax errors while rapidly building payloads.
  • Stealth: Spoof any USB identifier (VID/PID), extended USB Identifier, and network MAC address. Port Stealthing (Elite Models) lets the Plug stay dormant until a payload is deployed. No logs. No detections.
  • HIDX StealthLink: Elite model: setup a bidirectional tunnel from Target Host > O.MG > Control Machine.
  • Encrypted Network C2: Elite models: Use an encrypted connection to access & control your O.MG from anywhere. Then disable the onboard WebUI to hide and protect your O.MG on untrusted networks. Compatible with any server that runs python.
  • Self-Destruct: Elite model: Make your legal team happy by ensuring sensitive payloads & loot are gone, and the O.MG Plug is fully inert. (recoverable with O.MG Programmer)
  • Geo-Fencing: Trigger payloads or other actions based on location. Keep your tool from falling out of scope! Ex: self-destruct if someone takes the O.MG Plug out of scope.
  • WiFi Triggers: Trigger payloads at long range with a single beacon.

ELITE

Feature Tier
Feature Elite
Keystroke Injection DuckyScript 3
Mouse Injection ✔
Payload Slots 50-300
Max Payload Size 1,500,000 keystrokes
Max Payload Speed 890 keys/sec
Geo-Fencing ✔
WiFi Triggers ✔
Port Stealthing ✔
Self-Destruct ✔
HIDX StealthLink ✔
Encrypted Network C2 ✔
All specs are based on devices using the latest Beta firmware

Usage Instructions

The O.MG Adaptor has three distinct modes:

  1. Programming
    Because the device acts as a standard USB device, it needs to be pushed into programming / DFU mode. This is done by using the "Programming Shield".

    The Programming Shield is connected to a host device, and the O.MG Plug is plugged into the Shield.

    The O.MG Plug can now be programmed: Its WIFI settings can be configured, and payloads and trigger settings can be uploaded to the device.

    Programming is possible via a web-interface or smartphone app.

  2. Deployed
    The device is 'Deployed' when it is connected to the target machine.
    It can be configured to have any USB identifier (VID/PID) or network MAC address. In this mode, the device is dormant until triggered.

  3. Triggered
    The device is triggered wirelessly via Wifi. It can be triggered by smartphone, or by dedicated remote control.

      Technical Specifications

        • Connector: USB-A, USB-C
        • Active Side: USB-C

entry.title: Packet Squirrel (Mark II)
entry.summary:
Vendor: Hak5
Type: Pen Testing
Price: 180.00

Introduction

The Hak5 Packet Squirrel Mark II is the latest and greatest iteration of the already powerful ethernet multi-tool.

Once installed into a network, you have complete control to intercept and manipulate the captured packets, via built-in tools, or your own Python, DuckyScript or Bash scripts.

Deploy multiple payloads on the Packet Squirrel Mark II via its physical switch, the web interface, or even the Linux CLI.

Available accessories include the Packet Squirrel Quick-Start Guide (29 pages), getting you up and running with hands-on examples, or the Packet Squirrel Textbook - featuring over 292 pages spanning the basics of network infrastructure, ethernet and protocol, up to advanced techniques of packet capture and manipulation.

Functionality at a glance

The Packet Squirrel is a high-performance headless Linux mini-computer, optimised for network operations.

Out-of-the box, the Pocket Squirrel is configured to provide fully-featured packet sniffing, DNS Spoofing, Reverse Shell / VPN, and a root shell access.

Central to the Packet Squirrel is its 4-way switch: Each switch position represents a configurable mode of operation. Flick the switch and trigger a specific payload. The configurable push-button and RGB LED provides instant incognito deployment and feedback of payloads.

Fully scriptable, and backed by Hak5's library of payloads, the Packet Squirrel is the perfect tool for Penetration Testers, System Administrators or Power-Users.

Inconspicuous and compact, it is designed to blend into the background when attached to a target network.

Typical use-cases include:

Penetration Testing

Establish reverse shells & VPNs. Poison DNS. Deploy Meterpreter. Exfiltrate network traffic.

System Administration

Securely tunnel to inside your trusted networks via OpenSSH from anywhere.

Power-Users

Protect yourself on hostile networks using the hardware firewall and VPN router.

Mark II Exclusive Features:

New DuckyScript Commands

20+ new DuckyScript functions, including DYNAMICPROXY, KILLPORT, SPOOFDNS, SELFDESTRUCT, KILLSTREAM..

Script in DuckyScript, Bash and Python

The Mark II Supports multiple scripting languages to meet every skill-set and scenario.

Pre-loaded Payloads

Multiple pre-loaded payloads, including: Sniffing, Capture Printing Tasks, DNS Interception, Network Blackhole, and many more.

Introduction

The Hak5 Plunder Bug is a compact, advanced LAN/Ethernet Tap that functions as a mini-switch, allowing for passive monitoring and active engagement via its USB-C port.

Bundled with an Android Root App that enabled packet-capture from your handset, and all necessary cross-platform connection scripts.

Functionality at a glance

The Plunder Bug is designed for System Administrators and Penetration Testers, providing previously impossible functionality from an ethernet tapping device.

In Passive Mode, network traffic can be sniffed, collected and analysed using tools such as WireShark. Combined with tools like pcapfex - automatically dump files recovered from sniffed data.

In Active Mode, the Plunder Bug acts as an unmanaged switch, essentially injecting your device into the network - allowing for standard network analysis and infiltration.

And, for those emergency situations where you need to get jacked into a network - it can even act as a simple USB-C to Ethernet Adaptor.

The O.MG Cable resembles an ordinary USB-cable with a highly covert secret. Invisibly concealed in the cable is a USB exploit framework allowing for HID-attacks remote via local or remote triggering of custom payloads.

While dormant, the O.MG cable functions as a regular USB Cable: Data Transfer, Recharging, etc. However, when triggered (via smartphone / computer / plugging in) - it executes its preprogrammed payload on the host device.

The O.MG Cable has three distinct modes:

  1. Programming
    Because the device acts as a standard USB cable, it needs to be pushed into programming / DFU mode. This is done by using the "Cable Programmer".

    The Cable Programmer is connected to a host device, and the O.MG cable is plugged into the Cable Programmer.

    The O.MG Cable can now be programmed: Its WIFI settings can be configured, and payloads and trigger settings can be uploaded to the device.

    Programming is possible via a web-interface or smartphone app.

  2. Deployed
    The device is 'Deployed' when it is connected to the target machine.
    It will operate as a standard USB cable, allowing for data transfer and power transfer. It is able to stay in this state indefinitely until it is triggered.

  3. Triggered
    The device is triggered wirelessly via Wifi. It can be triggered by smartphone, or by dedicated remote control.

entry.title: O.MG Malicious Cable Detector
entry.summary:
Vendor: Hak5
Type: Pen Testing
Price: 69.00

Introduction

﻿﻿This is the updated (2023) version of the product.

The O.MG Malicious Cable Detector is a device designed to detect and protect against malicious cables such as the O.MG cable or the USBNinja.

The device samples a connected cable 200,000 times per second to analyse USB traffic. If traffic is detected - the cable can be considered to be malicious.

The Cable Detector can also be used as a "USB Condom" - allowing you to charge devices while it blocks the data lines, to eliminate the risk of "juice jacking".

The device's behaviour can also be extended via its 6-pin ISP header with the standard Arduino IDE. There's even a serial breakout, should you need to provide further output information.

Usage Instructions

Using the Malicious Cable Detector is incredibly easy:

  1. Plug the Malicious Cable Detector to a USB-A Port
    The Malicious Cable Detector needs power to operate. It can be plugged into any standard USB-A port or USB Battery.

  2. Connect a cable to test
    Plug a suspect cable into the Malicious Cable Detector.
    Important: Ensure that the cable is not plugged into anything else.

  3. Triage
    If the Malicious Cable Detector's LED shows signs of activity, this indicates that the cable is actively trying to send data / manipulate the host device.
